# National Education Policy Center

> NEPC conducts rigorous research and policy analysis on critical education issues including equity, funding, school choice, and special education.

The National Education Policy Center (NEPC) is a research organization that produces evidence-based policy briefs and research analyses on education policy issues. NEPC collaborates with leading education researchers and institutions to inform policy debates and support equitable education practices.

## Key Topics

- Education Policy
- Education Equity
- Public School Funding
- School Choice
- Special Education
- Policy Briefs
- Research Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence in Education
- National Education Policy Center
- Education Reform

## Research & Policy Analysis

- [National Education Policy Center](https://nepc.colorado.edu): NEPC homepage: research and policy briefs on education equity, funding, and school choice
